This case report tells the story of a 57-year-old woman with rare uterine metastasis of EGFR L858R-mutant advanced lung adenocarcinoma. The patient progressed after 16 months of first-line furmonertinib. NGS of uterine lesions detected concurrent EGFR and ALK alterations, and FISH verified MET polysomy. This is a rare case report of uterine metastasis after furmonertinib resistance with three simultaneous gene aberrations. Repeated genetic testing is vital for progressive patients to guide subsequent combination targeted treatments.
